notes.title: Hotfix for March 13
notes.notes: - Fixed a bug that caused a crash when selecting enemy units

notes.title: Bug Fixes for February 28
notes.notes:
- Fixed: Ghoul throw indicator not disappearing correctly.
- Fixed: Crash when switching to the main menu.
- Fixed: "MaxTree" cheat not functioning.
- Tutorial boss now wields a sword instead of a staff.

notes.title: Hotfix for October 17
notes.notes: - Fixed a bug that made playing impossible

notes.title: Bugfix Updates for May 5
notes.notes:
- Fixed bugs caused by picking up stuff with two ghouls at once
- Fatalistic dash is more convenient now
- Fixed fatalistic getting stuck in dash
- Dance is now on a hotkey (Control: c)
- Created action to jump to random living enemy (Control: t)
- Fixed a bug where ghouls would not reproduce
- Fixed a bug where ghouls get stuck when trying to eat
- Fixed ghouls removing itself from selection
- Fixed selection visual bug
- Enemy AI handles dangerous situations now differently
- Ghouls won't get stuck on slope edges no more
- Fixed more bugs

notes.title: AI Improvements, Bugfixes & Balancing for Apr 29
notes.notes:
- Upgraded to Unity 2021 to prepare for optimizations
- Lots of Enemy AI bug fixes
- Improved Enemy AI operations
- Increased lightning & poison spellcost
- Enemies will throw weapons more often now
- Fixed a bunch of bugs causing crashes

notes.title: Bugfix & Polish Updates for Mar 5
notes.notes:
- Resolved an issue with incorrect experience at end of game
- Addressed a crash issue related to missing pick-up references in ghouls
- Buildings now become non-collidable after destruction
- Improved target selection
- Upgraded cursors for building interactions
- Introduced 'Insane' difficulty level
- Implemented final experience multiplier feedback at end of game

notes.title: Bugfix Updates for Feb 26
notes.notes:
- Improve Workaholic run animations
- Fix bug causing crash by pickups
- Fix lightning damage calculations
- Better scenario clean up after finish
- Fix bug causing crash by hovering skill slots
- Fix loading screen ghouls speed on low resolutions
